name: Palas de Rei to Arzúa
notes: San Xiao do Camiño is the Galician name of what guides call San Xulián do Camiño (OSM hamlet 'San Xiao'). Boente has an upper and a lower hamlet (Boente de Arriba, node 6083648741, is 0.3 km east); the lower one is used. Ribadiso de Abaixo is at the medieval bridge over the Iso; A Castañeda (between Boente and Ribadiso) was not looked up. Melide is where the Camino Primitivo joins and Arzúa where the Camino del Norte joins (general knowledge). Arzúa: the place=town node 764265956 is used. Nominatim's search returns only the municipality relation 342625, whose centroid (42.92375,-8.15282) falls on road DP-7901 in the hamlet of Ponte Lema, 0.9 km from the town, so do not use it.
